description: Defines template classes for key-value pairs, including a generic KeyValueType and a case-sensitive text key-value specialization, within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: A template class representing a key-value pair with comparison and access methods.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: A specialized template class for text-based key-value pairs with case sensitivity options.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying key-value pairs.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns a reference to the key.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns a reference to the value.

methods.name: IsKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key matches the stored key.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks if the text key is non-empty.

methods.name: IsKey (TextFragment)
methods.description: Checks if the provided text key matches the stored key, considering case sensitivity.
